text.name: Arrest of Aldrich Ames
text.rules: Record "mole exposed". LIO spends 1 point. SAE's hand is shown to LIO. Draw from LIO's Contingency deck. If the result is 4 or more, LIO spends 1 point; otherwise, SAE spends 1 point.
text.history: Aldrich Ames, a CIA counter-intelligence officer, was arrested on 21 February 1994 after nine years of spying for the Soviet Union and Russia; his betrayal exposed many Western agents.
